# Run neo's agent review check from the shared Skills workflow

## Context

neomjs/neo-agent-skills#22 published neo's agent review policy as the package export `neo-agent-skills/pr-review-policy` plus `reusable-pr-review.yml` (0.1.73, neomjs/neo-agent-skills#233). It was extracted from neo's inline `.github/workflows/agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml`. Executed as-is, the inline script agrees with the package on 344 real reviews and 1,391 mutated copies, except one intended skeleton delta recorded on neomjs/neo-agent-skills#233. neomjs/neo-agent-skills#236 gave the workflow its first live caller, in Skills itself, and merged on 2026-10-29 at 12:00Z. This ticket is neo's caller leaf under neomjs/neo-agent-skills#14.

## The Problem

neo still runs its own 605-line copy, and the two have already drifted:
- CodeQL flagged the polynomial `**Status:**` capture in the package, where it is now a line scan (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#233). neo's copy still has it at `agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml:105`.
- Its `agentReviewers` list still names retired handles (`neo-gemini-pro`, `neo-gpt`), one of the surfaces neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1174 lists. The `neo-` prefix test, which the package also uses, already covers every agent.
- It posts a new corrective comment on every failing run. The package edits one comment per review in place.
- Every policy change has to land twice, for example the premise verdict that `#13144` asks for, or the pr-review cut in neomjs/neo-agent-skills#237.

## The Architectural Reality

- **No required check changes.** neo's required checks on `dev` (repository rulesets) are `baseline / *` from `reusable-pr-baseline.yml@v0.1.59`, plus `build-all`, `unit`, `components (1–3/3)` and `e2e-engine`. The review lint is not among them, so its check name can change without blocking a merge. That is by design: a new head carries no review result until the next review.
- **Nothing else references the inline workflow.** `git grep` over tracked files finds no reference, and neither does a search of `.agents`, `learn`, `ai`, `buildScripts` and `test`.
- **The activation issue becomes an input.** The reusable workflow's `budget_activation_issue` input replaces the inline `activationIssueNumber = 15257`. Its base defaults to `dev`, the inline value. neo is the only consumer whose history predates the review budget, so this caller is the only live test of the activation-history read and its `issues: read` grant.
- **A fourth coordinate.** neo pins Skills at `@v0.1.59` for the baseline and Dependabot workflows, and this caller adds `@v0.1.74`. neomjs/neo-agent-skills#80 (three coordinates, nothing compares them) gets a fourth until neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144 moves the coordinates together.

## The Fix

1. Delete `.github/workflows/agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml` (605 lines).
2. Add `.github/workflows/pr-review.yml` in the Skills caller's shape:
   - trigger: `pull_request_review: [submitted, edited]`;
   - grant: `contents: read`, `issues: read`, `pull-requests: write`;
   - `uses: neomjs/neo-agent-skills/.github/workflows/reusable-pr-review.yml@v0.1.74`, with `budget_activation_issue: 15257`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The inline workflow is gone. `pr-review.yml` calls `reusable-pr-review.yml@v0.1.74` with `budget_activation_issue: 15257` and exactly the grant above.
- [ ] AC-2 (live, on this ticket's PR): an agent review runs `review / Review body`, and its cohort step reads #15257's closing history under the caller's `issues: read` grant. The policy resolves that history only for a Request Changes, which an author cannot post on their own PR, so the resolution is shown by running the published package on the same live history; the first agent Request Changes after the merge is the live check.
- [ ] AC-3 (live, on this ticket's PR): a failing agent review produces one `github-actions[bot]` correction comment, and an edit that still fails updates that comment instead of adding one.
- [ ] Post-merge: the next agent review on any other neo PR shows `review / Review body`.
- [ ] Post-merge: the first agent Request Changes on a neo PR created after the merge is judged without `BUDGET_ACTIVATION_UNPROVABLE`.

## Out of Scope

- The callers for Brain, Institution and Stage, and Brain's adoption of the policy in `PullRequestService`. Each is its own leaf under neomjs/neo-agent-skills#14.
- Making the check required. It is informative by design.
- Moving neo's `@v0.1.59` coordinates, which belongs to neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144 and neomjs/neo-agent-skills#80.
- `#13144`'s premise verdict. Its CI landing pad moves to the Skills policy.
